articleTitle: Review on the terahertz metamaterial biosensor
publicationTitle: IET Ph.D Candidates Academic Seminar (China) on Vacuum Electronics (PhASe-VE 2021)
abstract: Metamaterials can be used to improve the sensitivity of the biosensor by designing the structures reasonably and enhancing the local resonances. THz wave has low photon energy, the radiation damage to tissues and organs in living organisms would be reduced greatly. Terahertz metamaterials sensor has bee attracted much attention. In this work, CiteSpace software is used to show a quantitative analysis of 152 papers from the Web of Science Core Collection database in 2011-2021. This systematical review is given from various aspects, such as co-cited analysis, leading collaborating countries and institutions, co-cited journals and keywords co-occurrence network, which would provide a multidimensional reference for researchers to have a clear grasp of the latest application progress in terahertz metamaterial biosensors.

articleTitle: Electron optical design of cold cathode based on silicon tip
publicationTitle: IET Ph.D Candidates Academic Seminar (China) on Vacuum Electronics (PhASe-VE 2021)
abstract: In this paper, a new electron optical design scheme of silicon tip field emission cathode electron gun is proposed based on the Pierce electron gun and Einzel lens design theory. The simulation optimization study is carried out by using Computer Simulation Software (CST). The results show that when the normal angle between the edge of the focusing electrode and the cathode plane is 42.0°, the Einzel lens focusing voltage is 144 V, an electron beam spot size of 8 nm can be obtained. It has potential applications in the field of high-resolution electron beam lithography and electron microscopy.

publicationTitle: IET Ph.D Candidates Academic Seminar (China) on Vacuum Electronics (PhASe-VE 2021)
abstract: A free-electron-driven terahertz vortex Smith-Purcell radiation (SPR) source based on spoof surface plasmon polaritons (SSPPs) carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) is proposed in this paper. The OAM-SSPPs exposed to the fast wave region are formed by periodically imposing the depth modulation on a double-slot helical grating, which results from the Brillouin-folding phenomenon. When a ring-shaped electron beam flies over the surface of the grating, the SSPPs will be excited and radiated into free space straightforward, thereby generating coherent vortex SPR at the frequency of SSPPs. The forming process of radiative SSPPs through Brillouin-folding is analyzed, and the spectrum of the coherent vortex SPR waves demonstrates the field enhancement effect of SSPPs. The proposed SSPPs-assisted coherent THz vortex SPR scheme is also generalizable to microwave and infrared frequencies and inspires novel vortex sources with enhanced power and tunable TCs.

articleTitle: Preliminarily design of a sub-terahertz high-order mode double-staggered grating waveguide for multiple-sheet electron beam traveling wave tubes
publicationTitle: IET Ph.D Candidates Academic Seminar (China) on Vacuum Electronics (PhASe-VE 2021)
abstract: At present, high-power terahertz (THz) radiation sources have received great attention. In order to increase the output power of sheet electron-beam devices, a sub-THz multiple-sheet electron beam traveling wave tube (TWT) with rectangular metal columns (RMCs) uniformly positioned along the wide side of the double-staggered grating waveguide (DSGW) is proposed in this article, contributing to the extended transverse dimension of the sheet electron beam. This SWS operates at high-order TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">51-like</sub> modes and the RMC is introduced to suppress the mode competition. The initial 3-D particle-in-cell (PIC) simulation predicts a maximum output power of >1404 W and a gain of > 34.5 dB at 220 GHz with the beam parameters of a voltage of 32 kV and a total current of 1.25 A (0.25 A×5).

articleTitle: The investigation on transmission characteristics of sheet beam TWT with V-shaped rectangle groove staggered double grating waveguide slow wave structure
publicationTitle: IET Ph.D Candidates Academic Seminar (China) on Vacuum Electronics (PhASe-VE 2021)
abstract: In this paper, the transmission characteristics based on a novel V-shaped rectangle groove staggered double grating waveguide (V-RG-SDGW) slow wave structure (SWS) is investigated, which is used in a 0.22 THz sheet beam traveling wave tube (TWT). the transmission characteristics of this tube is optimized by tapered SWS with five periods and the bend couplers structure from groove waveguide to rectangle waveguide. According to the simulation results, it is shown that the magnitude of S11 is less than −15 dB from 199 GHz to 240 GHz.

articleTitle: The modulation investigation of 2π and π modes for Extended Interaction Klystron
publicationTitle: IET Ph.D Candidates Academic Seminar (China) on Vacuum Electronics (PhASe-VE 2021)
abstract: Based on the principle of electron motion equation, the trajectory of different time-phase electrons in the electric field of 2π mode and π mode is investigated. And the magnitude of modulation can be obtained from the trajectory. The factors affecting overmodulation have been analyzed. In addition, two methods include increasing the modulation electric field and decreasing period length are analyzed to improve the magnitude of modulation.

articleTitle: Solutions for short circuit failure of Spindt cathode
publicationTitle: IET Ph.D Candidates Academic Seminar (China) on Vacuum Electronics (PhASe-VE 2021)
abstract: According to the current development status of Spindt cathode, this paper puts forward the problem that the short circuit failure between emitter and gate seriously affects the yield of Spindt cathode. It was found that the adhesion of metal particles inside the emission unit is the main cause of short circuit. The formation of the particles was investigated. Improvement measures were proposed from the aspect of process to fundamentally avoid the formation of the particles. And the emission unit structure was optimized to make an easier washout of the already formed particles from the cathode cavities. Furthermore, some cleaning techniques were analysed which were expected to effectively remove the firmly adhered metal particles. These feasible solutions to solve the short circuit failure of Spindt cathode are the basis of follow-up research work, and are of great significance for the preparation of Spindt field emission cathode suitable for microwave vacuum electronic devices.

articleTitle: Design and experiment of device for sheet beam TWT electron gun cathode and focusing electrode assembly
publicationTitle: IET Ph.D Candidates Academic Seminar (China) on Vacuum Electronics (PhASe-VE 2021)
abstract: In this paper, we present the design and experiment of a semi-automatic device for sheet beam traveling wave tube (TWT) electron gun cathode and focusing electrode assembly, which include cathode positioning module, focusing electrode positioning module, concentricity adjustment and clamping module, angle adjustment module, auxiliary support structure and automatic geometric measurement module. Using this device, it only takes 20 minutes to adjust the concentricity of the cathode and the focusing electrode to 30 microns and the angle to 0.5 degrees. In the subsequent welding process, the whole device remains clamped, the welding deformation can be limited to 10 microns. This device applied to the following W band TWT manufacturing, with rectangular waveguide grating slow wave structure (SWS), using a 32 kV, 550 mA electron beam, the measured peak power is over 2 kilowatts and the average output power is over 100 watts with 5% duty cycle at the frequency around 91.5 – 96 GHz. The results of the above sheet beam TWT test will be detailed in a subsequent manuscript.

articleTitle: Theoretical investigation on a 1-THz third harmonic gyrotron
publicationTitle: IET Ph.D Candidates Academic Seminar (China) on Vacuum Electronics (PhASe-VE 2021)
abstract: In this paper, a 1-THz TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15,9</sub> mode third harmonic gyrotron is numerically designed by the selfconsistent non-linear theory. With the beam voltage of 20.8 kV, the beam current of 0.95 A, the output power is 2.3 kW and the maximum beam-wave interaction efficiency is 12%. Meanwhile, by using the time-dependent multi-mode nonlinear theory, the mode competitions of the gyrotron are investigated. The effects of electron beam voltage, beam current, pitch angle and magnetic field to the efficiency are also analyzed in detail.

articleTitle: Theoretical study on the empty orbit for atomic bonding layer of graphene covered nickel interface
publicationTitle: IET Ph.D Candidates Academic Seminar (China) on Vacuum Electronics (PhASe-VE 2021)
abstract: The surface secondary electron yield of aerospace microwave devices can be reduced by surface treatment including metal coating, amorphous carbonation and roughening. This paper focuses on the treatment of metal coating combined with graphene covered, theoretically analyzes the feasible mechanism of reducing SEY behind this treatment operation, and studies more in the exploration directions led by this mechanism. A theoretical mechanism of empty orbit for atomic bonding layer and an equivalent dipole model hypothesis are proposed.

articleTitle: Study of a terahertz-band high-order mode orthogonal grating waveguide slow-wave structure
publicationTitle: IET Ph.D Candidates Academic Seminar (China) on Vacuum Electronics (PhASe-VE 2021)
abstract: The combination of dual sheet electron beams and high-order mode planar slow-wave structure (SWS) contributes to a high output power of the terahertz-band traveling wave tube. In this paper, a novel orthogonal grating waveguide (OGW) operating in the TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</sub>-like mode has been proposed and studied. Compared with the fundamental-mode single rectangular grating waveguide, it is capable of supporting dual sheet electron beams and possesses larger geometric dimensions. Compared with our previously reported OGW, this SWS has adopted a V-shaped grating, which contributes to a higher transmission. A 120-period upgraded orthogonal grating SWS circuit is designed. For a cold test, two identical TE□<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub>-TE□<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</sub> mode converters are introduced at the two ends of the SWS circuit. Simulation results show that the transmission and reflection coefficients are higher than −1.6 dB and lower than −10.0 dB in the frequency range of 232.9–276.6 GHz, respectively. A prototype of the designed OGW has been fabricated by Nano-CNC technique and will be measured by using an H-band Vector Network Analyzer.

articleTitle: Multiband polarization-insensitive tunable absorber based on Weyl semimetals
publicationTitle: IET Ph.D Candidates Academic Seminar (China) on Vacuum Electronics (PhASe-VE 2021)
abstract: The density of electric and magnetic fields reveals the physical mechanisms of absorption phenomenon. This paper presents perfect multiband absorbers formed by Weyl semimetals (WSMs) and dielectric layers over a metallic ground plane. The tunability of absorption frequencies is achieved by changing the WSM chemical potential. Multiband absorbers show absorptivity over 99% and are insensitive to the polarization angle of electromagnetic waves. The proposed absorber has significant potential in terahertz detection, radar stealth, and biological monitoring.

articleTitle: A novel U-shaped meander-line slow wave structure for Ka-band TWT
publicationTitle: IET Ph.D Candidates Academic Seminar (China) on Vacuum Electronics (PhASe-VE 2021)
abstract: In this paper, a novel U-shape meander-line slow wave structure (MLSWS) is proposed for the miniaturization of millimeter-wave traveling-wave tubes (TWTs). This slow wave structure can effectively reduce the working voltage. The dispersion and transmission characteristics of the SWS have been analyzed. According to the simulation results, when the working voltage and current of 10 kV and 160 mA respectively, 176.7 W output power can be obtained at 37 GHz.

articleTitle: Simulation on input coupler for Ka-band TE21 large orbit gyro-TWT
publicationTitle: IET Ph.D Candidates Academic Seminar (China) on Vacuum Electronics (PhASe-VE 2021)
abstract: An input coupler is designed for Ka-band TE21 large orbit gyro-TWT. The coupler converts the rectangular waveguide TE10 mode to the circular waveguide TE21 mode required for the gyrotron traveling wave tube. The input coupler has an important effect on the performance of gyro-TWT. The structure size of the TE21 mode was given by theoretical analysis. The input coupler of Ka-band large orbit gyro-TWT is simulated and designed by using CST simulation software, the influence of the length and width of the coupling gap on the S parameter is studied. By optimizing the size of the rectangular coupling hole, this input coupler can achieve a 1dB bandwidth of about 4.18GHz, with the reflection coefficient below -15dB in the frequency range of 33.3 to 37.5GHz. The simulation results show that the coupler can be applied to large orbit gyro-TWT with wide band and high power.

articleTitle: Millimeter-wave near-field holographic imaging based on VNA
publicationTitle: IET Ph.D Candidates Academic Seminar (China) on Vacuum Electronics (PhASe-VE 2021)
abstract: Millimeter-Wave (MMW) imaging technology has been used to detect concealed weapons and contraband carried by personnel in airports and other security locations. In this paper, the MMW near-field holographic imaging based on the vector network analyzer (VNA) is researched. A VNA test system with the MMW horn antennas is established to verify the feasibility of near-field holographic imaging. The MMW image is reconstructed using the wavenumber-domain (ω-k) algorithm. Experimental results confirm that the effectiveness of the VNA test system in near-field holographic imaging.

articleTitle: Development of a high-harmonics gyrotron based on large-orbit gun
publicationTitle: IET Ph.D Candidates Academic Seminar (China) on Vacuum Electronics (PhASe-VE 2021)
abstract: Experimental design for a fourth-harmonic gyrotron is demonstrated in this manuscript. A magnetic cusp gun is used to excite the operating modes. The gun can generate 1-A beams at 80 kV in the range of 8 T ∼ 10.5 T with a velocity spread lower than 3%. The pitch factor of electron beams is 1.5. The strength of the magnetic field of the superconducting magnet is 10.3 T. Based on the simulation results, electromagnetic energy up to 2.1 kW at 1.002 THz employing the TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4,8</sub> mode can be generated under these setups. Besides, the gyrotron can be tuned in the range of 8 T ∼ 10.5 T, which the operating modes can be switched in the TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3,5</sub>, the TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3,6</sub>, and the TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4,8</sub> modes sequentially.
